{{Quote|There have been sightings of a great beast&mdash;"She Who Greedily Devours." Now we know her ferocity outstrips our scouts and hunters.|[[Arankau]]|<ref name="Shadow">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''She Who Greedily Devours''' was the name given by the [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] natives of [[Sky Ridge Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragon]] that settled on their island.<ref name="Daily" /> "'''Kellie'''", as she was originally known, was brought to Rishi as a hatchling to be the mascot of a new [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] chapter of the [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang; however, she soon grew too large and ferocious to keep, and the pirates' leader [[Kai Zykken]] dumped her into a garbage scow in order to avoid bankrupting his gang on food for her. Kellie gorged herself on irradiated refuse for [[Standard day/Legends|days]], causing her to grow particularly large and aggressive,<ref name="Codex" /> and she made a nest for herself in a cave on Sky Ridge Island, where she terrorized the native Rishii until [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an offworlder.<ref name="Daily" />
